review_type: Constructor semantic review of the supplied English wording; not independent final audit

shared_output_definition.requirement: The two output_format strings must be exactly equal. They jointly define output size, column order, pair identity, deduplication, sorting, and NONE. rules.json supplies the corresponding scorer fields and composite row key.

predicates.cg_quote: Identify every drug entry in the mycophenolic-acid chemical drug group whose own annotation names the active drug form produced from that prodrug. Return all qualifying drug-ID pairs.
predicates.go_quote: Identify every drug entry in the mycophenolic-acid chemical drug group whose own annotation names the active drug form produced from that prodrug. Return all qualifying drug-ID pairs.

predicates.cg_quote: Use the records observed on 12 September 2026.
predicates.go_quote: Use the records observed on 12 September 2026.

predicates.cg_quote: Scope is limited to the direct drug entries in the complete Member field of DG00739, the mycophenolic-acid group with Type Chemical.
predicates.go_quote: Scope is limited to the direct drug entries in the complete Member field of DG00739, the mycophenolic-acid group with Type Chemical.

predicates.cg_quote: Include a member only if its own Comment field explicitly states "Active form of prodrug:" and identifies the active form with a drug reference, "[DR:D...]".
predicates.go_quote: A member qualifies only if its own Comment field explicitly states "Active form of prodrug:" and identifies the active form with a drug reference, "[DR:D...]".

predicates.cg_quote: Record the member's D identifier as PRODRUG_D and each explicitly linked active-form D identifier as ACTIVE_D.
predicates.go_quote: PRODRUG_D is the member's D identifier; ACTIVE_D is an explicitly linked active-form D identifier.

predicates.cg_quote: Verify each linked identifier against its drug record.
predicates.go_quote: Each linked identifier must be verified against its drug record.

predicates.cg_quote: Keep distinct salt-form drug entries separate, even when names or products overlap.
predicates.go_quote: Keep distinct salt-form drug entries separate, even when names or products overlap.

predicates.cg_quote: Group membership and group-level Prodrugs links do not establish an entry's own relation.
predicates.go_quote: Group membership and group-level Prodrugs links do not establish an entry's own relation.

predicates.cg_quote: Use drug identifiers (D...); compound identifiers (C...) and group identifiers (DG...) cannot replace them.
predicates.go_quote: Use drug identifiers (D...); compound identifiers (C...) and group identifiers (DG...) cannot replace them.

predicates.cg_quote: Read each member's complete drug record.
predicates.go_quote: The result must account for the complete drug record of every member in scope.

predicates.cg_quote: A fully read record without the required annotation is excluded only from this documented-relation query; this does not establish that the drug is biologically not a prodrug.
predicates.go_quote: A fully read record without the required annotation is excluded only from this documented-relation query; this does not establish that the drug is biologically not a prodrug.

predicates.cg_quote: An unavailable or incomplete required record leaves the result unresolved and must not be treated as an exclusion or an empty result.
predicates.go_quote: An unavailable or incomplete required record leaves the result unresolved and must not be treated as an exclusion or an empty result.

predicates.cg_quote: Return only pipe-separated text. For a nonempty result, use the header PRODRUG_D|ACTIVE_D and one row per distinct ordered pair of drug identifiers.
predicates.go_quote: Return only pipe-separated text. For a nonempty result, use the header PRODRUG_D|ACTIVE_D and one row per distinct ordered pair of drug identifiers.

predicates.cg_quote: Include every qualifying pair, including every explicitly linked active form when a member has more than one. Remove duplicate pairs.
predicates.go_quote: Include every qualifying pair, including every explicitly linked active form when a member has more than one. Remove duplicate pairs.

predicates.cg_quote: Sort by PRODRUG_D in ascending string order, then by ACTIVE_D in ascending string order.
predicates.go_quote: Sort by PRODRUG_D in ascending string order, then by ACTIVE_D in ascending string order.

predicates.cg_quote: If the fully verified result is empty, return only NONE, without a header. Add no prose or code fences.
predicates.go_quote: If the fully verified result is empty, return only NONE, without a header. Add no prose or code fences.

ambiguity_checks.issue: Own annotation versus a group-level Prodrugs link
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: Use only the member's explicit own Comment relation.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Propagate the group's Prodrugs association to all group members.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: A includes D00752 and D05094 as source entries. B would additionally admit D05095 and D05096 without own relation evidence.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts explicitly require the own Comment and reject group-link propagation.

ambiguity_checks.issue: Independent salt identity versus one product or ingredient family
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: Retain the distinct qualifying D entries.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Merge the qualifying hydrochloride with ordinary mofetil under their shared product or parent name.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: A retains two source D identities. B collapses them to one, changing the result.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts explicitly preserve distinct salt-form entries even when names or products overlap.

ambiguity_checks.issue: Direction of the phrase Active form of prodrug
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: The current member is PRODRUG_D and its linked active form is ACTIVE_D.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Treat the current record as the active form and reverse the link.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: B reverses both ordered pairs and produces a different pair set.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts explicitly assign each column to its source role.

ambiguity_checks.issue: Drug identity versus a Same as compound cross-reference
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Replace the active drug with its C20380 cross-reference.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: B changes the target identifier in both rows.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts prohibit replacing D identifiers with C or DG identifiers.

ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: Exclude only after reading the complete record; failed retrieval is unresolved.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Treat unreadable records as having no qualifying annotation.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: The supplied complete records support the same exclusions under A. In the documented earlier access-failure situation, B could remove unseen qualifying members or produce a false empty result, whereas A remains unresolved.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts distinguish complete-record absence from unavailable or incomplete evidence.

ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: Use the stated 12 September 2026 source observation.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Require reconstruction of the 9 September evaluation-date state.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: A has complete supplied evidence. The historical set under B is unknown; no difference or historical equality is asserted.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Only the source observation date appears publicly. The evaluation date is private metadata.

ambiguity_checks.issue: Direct drug scope versus recursive expansion or requiring targets to be group members
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_a: Only source drugs must be direct members; active forms are the explicit linked D identities.
ambiguity_checks.interpretation_b: Expand into subgroups or also impose group membership on targets.
ambiguity_checks.effect_on_supplied_sources: No observed set difference: there are no subgroups and all observed targets already have member records. Neither extra restriction is needed.
ambiguity_checks.resolution: Both prompts specify direct source entries and linked active forms. Target membership is not a private predicate.

constraints_not_present: There is no numeric eligibility threshold, approval-date filter, winner selection, or fixed public row count.
sequence_difference: CG gives group enumeration, member reading, and target verification steps. GO states the same scope and evidence requirements without prescribing their sequence.
